howItFalls: A Cesgranrio, em provas bancárias, apresenta um texto em inglês sobre economia, finanças, tecnologia ou comportamento do consumidor, seguido de questões A–E em inglês. O padrão é bem regular: uma pergunta de ideia principal, uma ou duas de informação explícita (“According to the text…”), uma de referência pronominal, uma de vocabulário em contexto e, às vezes, uma de conectivo ou de tempo verbal. Um item típico pergunta a que se refere “this” em determinado parágrafo, e o distrator aponta o substantivo imediatamente anterior, quando o pronome retoma a ideia inteira da frase anterior. Outro exemplo é a pergunta sobre o sentido de “figures” em texto financeiro: quem pensa em figuras erra, porque ali significa números, dados. A profundidade é intermediária, com vocabulário do mundo bancário e digital (fintech, savings, loans, fees, mobile banking). Os distratores misturam palavras do texto em frases que dizem outra coisa. Pesa menos a gramática pura, e quase nunca aparece tradução literal de trechos longos.
tips: Construa um glossário de termos financeiros em inglês: loan, debt, interest rate, savings, fee, revenue, figures.
Em “According to the text”, localize o trecho e confira cada palavra da alternativa.
Lembre que “this” e “that” podem retomar uma ideia inteira, não apenas um substantivo.
Para ideia principal, escolha a alternativa que abrange o texto todo, não um parágrafo.
Desconfie de alternativas que copiam palavras do texto em ordem diferente.
traps: “Figures, no texto financeiro, significa ilustrações” → no contexto econômico figures são números → o sentido é dados, cifras.
“This retoma o substantivo imediatamente anterior” → pode retomar a ideia da frase inteira → leia a frase anterior completa.
“Fees são lucros do banco” → fees são tarifas cobradas → lucro seria profit ou earnings.
“A ideia principal é o exemplo do segundo parágrafo” → um exemplo é detalhe de apoio → a ideia principal cobre o texto inteiro.

Read the text. "Open banking, open questions" — Open banking allows customers to share their financial data with third-party providers through secure application programming interfaces. Supporters argue that the model increases competition, since smaller firms can offer tailored products based on a fuller picture of a client's finances. A borrower who has always paid bills on time, for instance, might obtain a lower interest rate even without a long credit history. Critics, however, warn that consent screens are often too long and too technical, so many users click "accept" without understanding what they are authorizing. Regulators have responded by requiring that data sharing be limited in time and revocable at any moment. Whether these safeguards will be enough remains to be seen, but one point is already clear: the success of open banking will depend less on technology than on trust.

According to the text, supporters of open banking believe that it

options.text: guarantees lower interest rates to all borrowers.
options.comentario: The text says a good payer "might" obtain lower rates.

options.text: replaces credit history with technical consent screens.
options.comentario: Consent screens are criticized, not a credit substitute.

options.text: prevents smaller firms from accessing financial data.
eliminates the need for consent from customers.
options.comentario: The text discusses consent screens; nothing says consent is eliminated.

options.text: fosters competition by allowing firms to design customized products.

questions.explanation: The second sentence states the supporters' view: more competition, because smaller firms can tailor products. Modal verbs like "might" signal possibility, not guarantee. Pegadinha: Treating "might obtain a lower rate" as a guarantee.

questions.explanation: "Otherwise" significa "caso contrário", ou seja, "se isso não acontecer". Por isso, equivale a "If not". O sentido é: sem educação financeira e preços transparentes, os benefícios continuarão limitados. "Therefore" indica conclusão, "moreover" indica adição e "meanwhile" indica simultaneidade. A armadilha é confundir "otherwise" com "therefore". Pegadinha: Confusing with "therefore".
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the text. — Financial inclusion has advanced quickly in emerging economies, largely because of mobile phones. In many regions where bank branches are scarce, people now open accounts, receive wages and pay bills without ever visiting an agency. Yet access is not the same as use. Surveys show that a significant share of new account holders leave their accounts inactive after the first months, either because fees seem unclear or because they do not trust digital transactions. Experts therefore argue that technology must be combined with financial education and transparent pricing. Otherwise, the number of accounts may grow while the real benefits for low-income families remain limited.

According to experts, the real benefits of inclusion depend on

options.text: reducing the number of accounts.
banning digital transactions.
increasing fees.
more bank branches only.
combining technology with financial education and transparent pricing.

questions.explanation: O texto afirma que os especialistas defendem combinar tecnologia com educação financeira e preços transparentes ("technology must be combined with financial education and transparent pricing"). Sem isso, o número de contas cresce, mas os benefícios reais ficam limitados. Nenhum trecho propõe reduzir contas, proibir transações digitais ou depender apenas de mais agências. Pegadinha: —
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The city library will open one hour earlier on weekdays beginning in June. Weekend hours will remain unchanged, and the children’s room will still close at 6 p.m.

According to the notice, what will change in June?

options.text: The library's weekday opening time.
The library's closing time every day.
The schedule of the children's room on weekends.
The number of books available for borrowing.
The library's weekend opening time.

questions.explanation: O aviso informa expressamente que a biblioteca abrirá uma hora mais cedo nos dias úteis. Os horários do fim de semana não serão alterados, e nada se afirma sobre acervo ou sobre mudança do encerramento diário.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Mara submitted her application on Monday. By Thursday, she had received no confirmation, although two colleagues who applied later had already heard back. She decided to contact the admissions office.

What can reasonably be inferred about Mara?

options.text: She knows that her application has been rejected.
She is concerned about the lack of confirmation.
She applied after both of her colleagues.
She plans to withdraw her application immediately.
She received a confirmation but lost the email.

questions.explanation: A decisão de contatar o setor, após observar respostas a candidatos posteriores, sugere preocupação com a ausência de confirmação. O texto não permite concluir rejeição, desistência nem recebimento prévio de mensagem.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
A recent survey of 600 commuters found that most respondents valued reliable bus arrivals more than free onboard Wi-Fi. The survey did not ask whether they would be willing to pay higher fares for improved service.

Which conclusion is supported by the survey?

options.text: All commuters would accept a fare increase.
Wi-Fi access was considered useless by every respondent.
Respondents placed greater value on punctual buses than on free Wi-Fi.
Higher fares are necessary to improve arrival times.
The survey established the views of every commuter in the city.

questions.explanation: O levantamento identifica uma preferência relativa pela confiabilidade dos ônibus em comparação ao Wi-Fi gratuito. Não investigou disposição para pagar mais, tampouco autoriza generalizar a todos os usuários da cidade.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
To reduce food waste, the cafeteria now serves smaller standard portions but allows customers to request a second helping at no extra charge. Staff say that fewer plates return with uneaten food.

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: The cafeteria has removed second helpings from its menu.
Customers must pay more to receive enough food.
Staff are required to weigh all returned plates.
A change in portion policy is associated with less discarded food.
The cafeteria has stopped serving standard portions.

questions.explanation: A ideia central liga porções iniciais menores, com repetição gratuita disponível, à diminuição das sobras relatada pela equipe. As demais afirmações contradizem a política descrita ou acrescentam exigências inexistentes.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Although the company expanded its online store last year, most of its sales still came from physical locations. Managers expect digital sales to grow, but they have not announced plans to close any shops.

Which statement best reflects the passage?

options.text: Online sales were the company's only source of income.
All physical stores are scheduled to close.
The online store was abandoned after its launch.
Management confirmed a date for closing the shops.
Physical stores remained the leading sales channel last year.

questions.explanation: O contraste introduzido por 'although' indica que a expansão digital não tirou das lojas físicas a liderança nas vendas. A expectativa de crescimento on-line não equivale a um anúncio de encerramento das unidades.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
During the pilot program, employees could choose to work remotely on Fridays. Participation was optional, and workers in customer-facing roles needed their supervisors' approval before joining.

Who could participate without first obtaining the specific approval mentioned?

options.text: Eligible workers who were not in customer-facing roles.
Every employee who served customers in person.
Only employees who had worked remotely before.
Anyone willing to work from home all week.
No employee, because participation was mandatory.

questions.explanation: O requisito explícito de autorização do supervisor recai sobre quem exerce atendimento ao público. Para os demais, o texto não impõe essa aprovação específica; participar era opcional e limitado às sextas-feiras.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
After a series of delays, the research team released preliminary findings rather than its full report. The authors stressed that the figures might change once the remaining data were checked.

What should readers avoid assuming?

options.text: That some data still need checking.
That the preliminary figures are final.
That the full report has not yet been released.
That the team acknowledged possible revisions.
That the reported findings are preliminary.

questions.explanation: Os pesquisadores apresentam resultados preliminares e avisam que os números podem mudar após a conferência dos dados restantes. Tratá-los como definitivos ignora essa ressalva; as demais leituras são expressamente sustentadas.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Students who missed the first workshop may watch a recording before attending the second session. However, the recording does not replace the short assessment required of all participants.

A student who missed the first workshop must still

options.text: attend a new first workshop in person.
pay a fee to access the recording.
complete the short assessment.
skip the second session altogether.
submit a second recording of the workshop.

questions.explanation: O texto afirma que a gravação pode ajudar quem faltou, mas não dispensa a avaliação exigida de todos. Não há previsão de taxa, reapresentação presencial da primeira oficina ou impedimento à segunda sessão.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
The committee described the proposal as 'feasible', provided that the existing staff could be trained within three months.

In this context, 'feasible' is closest in meaning to

options.text: mandatory.
unpopular.
already completed.
practicable.
financially profitable.

questions.explanation: 'Feasible' qualifica algo que pode ser realizado, sob a condição de capacitação da equipe. O termo não expressa obrigação, rejeição, execução concluída nem lucratividade, sentidos que dependeriam de outras informações.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The editor asked the journalist to 'look into' the discrepancy between the two figures before publishing the article.

The expression 'look into' means to

options.text: ignore.
translate.
illustrate.
approve without checking.
investigate.

questions.explanation: No contexto de divergência entre números, 'look into' significa examinar ou investigar o problema. A orientação ocorre antes da publicação e não se confunde com ignorar, traduzir, ilustrar ou aprovar sem conferir.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The manager said that the new office would 'eventually' accommodate all regional teams, even though only one department would move there this year.

The word 'eventually' indicates that the move will happen

options.text: at some point in the future.
by chance and without planning.
only if an emergency occurs.
immediately after the announcement.
occasionally, but never on a regular basis.

questions.explanation: 'Eventually' indica um resultado esperado em algum momento futuro, não 'eventualmente' no sentido de possibilidade ocasional. A mudança parcial neste ano reforça a realização gradual, sem afirmar acaso ou urgência.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The company issued a 'comprehensive' guide covering recruitment, onboarding, payroll and workplace safety.

In the passage, 'comprehensive' suggests that the guide is

options.text: difficult to obtain.
wide-ranging.
brief and incomplete.
strictly confidential.
written only for financial experts.

questions.explanation: A enumeração de diferentes assuntos mostra que 'comprehensive' significa abrangente. O adjetivo não indica sigilo, dificuldade de acesso, brevidade ou restrição a especialistas em finanças, sentidos não apoiados pelo contexto.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
During the negotiations, both sides agreed to 'meet halfway' on the delivery schedule instead of insisting on their original deadlines.

The expression 'meet halfway' conveys the idea of

options.text: ending the negotiation without agreement.
sharing a ride to the delivery site.
making mutual concessions.
meeting at the midpoint of a route.
allowing only one side to impose its deadline.

questions.explanation: 'Meet halfway' é expressão idiomática para chegar a um compromisso com concessões recíprocas. A referência aos prazos originais afastados impede a leitura literal de encontro geográfico ou imposição unilateral.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The applicant was asked to provide 'actual' expenses for the trip, not rough estimates prepared before departure.

The adjective 'actual' refers to expenses that were

options.text: expected next year.
updated every hour.
approved in advance.
really incurred.
unrelated to the journey.

questions.explanation: 'Actual expenses' são gastos efetivamente realizados, em oposição às estimativas anteriores à viagem. O falso cognato não significa simplesmente 'atuais' ou atualizados; tampouco pressupõe aprovação antecipada.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The consultant warned that cutting the training budget could 'backfire' if avoidable mistakes later became more frequent.

Here, 'backfire' means to

options.text: guarantee immediate savings without side effects.
increase the number of training sessions.
make a policy legally unenforceable.
delay a plan without affecting its results.
produce an outcome opposite to what was intended.

questions.explanation: 'Backfire' descreve efeito contraproducente: a economia pretendida pode gerar mais erros e custos indiretos. Não significa assegurar poupança, aumentar treinamentos nem apenas retardar a execução da medida.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
The supervisor called the intern's suggestion 'sensible' because it reduced unnecessary steps without adding risks.

In this passage, 'sensible' is best understood as

options.text: reasonable.
highly emotional.
easily offended.
physically sensitive.
unrelated to practical judgment.

questions.explanation: 'Sensible' caracteriza a proposta como razoável e prudente, pois reduz etapas sem elevar riscos. Em português, a semelhança com 'sensível' pode induzir erro, mas o contexto trata de julgamento prático.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
When the auditors arrived, the finance team had already corrected the spreadsheet.

What does the past perfect indicate?

options.text: The correction will occur after the auditors leave.
The correction preceded the auditors' arrival.
The auditors corrected the spreadsheet themselves.
Both actions necessarily took place at the same instant.
The finance team had not begun the correction.

questions.explanation: O past perfect em 'had already corrected' marca uma ação concluída antes de outro ponto passado, a chegada dos auditores. Não transfere a correção aos auditores nem indica simultaneidade ou ação futura.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Employees must wear identification badges in the laboratory, but they may leave them in their lockers when working in the public reception area.

What distinction do the modal verbs establish?

options.text: An obligation to wear badges in every part of the building.
A prohibition against storing badges in lockers.
A requirement in one location and permission in another.
A mere suggestion to wear badges in the laboratory.
A statement that no identification rules exist.

questions.explanation: 'Must' impõe o uso de crachá no laboratório, enquanto 'may' concede permissão para deixá-lo no armário na recepção pública. Confundir obrigação com sugestão ou permissão com proibição distorce a regra.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
If the supplier delivers the parts by Friday, the engineers will finish the prototype next week.

The sentence presents completion next week as

options.text: guaranteed regardless of the supplier's actions.
an event that was completed last week.
impossible even if the parts arrive in time.
dependent on delivery by Friday.
dependent on the engineers having finished yesterday.

questions.explanation: O primeiro condicional relaciona uma condição possível no futuro — entrega até sexta — ao resultado previsto na semana seguinte. A frase não assegura o resultado incondicionalmente nem descreve fato consumado.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The software may have deleted the temporary files during the update. The support team is still checking the logs.

What degree of certainty does 'may have deleted' express?

options.text: Proof that deletion definitely occurred.
A command to delete the files now.
A promise that no files were removed.
An ability that the software will acquire later.
A possibility concerning a past event.

questions.explanation: 'May have' seguido de particípio indica possibilidade relativa a fato passado, não certeza. A análise dos registros ainda em curso confirma a cautela; o enunciado tampouco expressa ordem ou promessa.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The new policy was introduced in April. It was revised two months later because several employees found its instructions unclear.

To what does the pronoun 'It' refer?

options.text: The new policy.
April.
The employees.
Two months.
The instructions alone.

questions.explanation: O pronome 'It' retoma 'the new policy', que foi implementada e, posteriormente, revisada. A referência coesiva é singular e compatível com o objeto de revisão; mês e empregados não exercem esse papel.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Had the technician checked the connection earlier, the outage might have been avoided.

The sentence implies that

options.text: the connection was definitely checked before the outage.
the technician did not check the connection early enough.
the outage will certainly be avoided tomorrow.
the technician has no responsibility for checking connections.
the outage was impossible under any circumstances.

questions.explanation: A inversão 'Had ... checked' equivale a 'If ... had checked', formando condição hipotética sobre o passado não realizado. 'Might have been avoided' aponta possibilidade, não garantia de evitar a falha.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The board has been reviewing the proposal since January, but no final decision has been made.

Which interpretation is consistent with the verb forms?

options.text: The review ended before January.
The board made a final decision in January.
The review began in January and remains relevant now.
The board will start its first review next year.
The proposal has already been permanently rejected.

questions.explanation: O present perfect continuous com 'since January' indica atividade iniciada naquele mês e com continuidade ou efeito no presente. A voz passiva negativa informa que ainda não houve decisão final.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
The maintenance window was extended; therefore, customers could not access the platform until 3 a.m.

The connector 'therefore' signals

options.text: an example unrelated to maintenance.
a contrast with the preceding statement.
a correction denying that maintenance occurred.
a consequence of the extended maintenance window.
a condition under which maintenance would be canceled.

questions.explanation: 'Therefore' introduz consequência lógica: a ampliação da manutenção explica a indisponibilidade até as três horas. Não sinaliza oposição, exemplo, negação do evento anterior ou condição hipotética.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Our town has plenty of parking spaces. What it lacks is a safe way for children to walk to school. Before building another car park, we should repair the sidewalks.

What is the writer's primary purpose?

options.text: To list the town's parking fees.
To describe a completed road repair project.
To announce a ban on children walking to school.
To prove that no resident uses a car.
To argue for prioritizing sidewalk repairs.

questions.explanation: O autor contrasta a oferta de estacionamento com a falta de segurança para pedestres e defende consertar calçadas antes de ampliar vagas. Trata-se de argumentação propositiva, não anúncio de obras concluídas.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
The new filing system was advertised as 'effortless'. After three hours of resetting passwords and calling support, the staff finally managed to log in.

The quotation marks around 'effortless' help create a tone of

options.text: irony.
admiration without reservation.
formal celebration.
complete indifference.
scientific neutrality about the system.

questions.explanation: As aspas em 'effortless', contrastadas com as horas gastas em problemas de acesso, produzem ironia sobre a promessa de facilidade. Não se trata de elogio literal nem de relato neutro sem avaliação implícita.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
First, the report outlines the causes of urban flooding. It then examines three engineering solutions and ends by comparing their costs and environmental impacts.

How is the report organized?

options.text: From a personal anecdote to a fictional ending.
From causes to solutions and then comparison.
From financial results to a list of employee benefits.
From legal penalties to unrelated historical dates.
From conclusions directly to an unexplained quotation.

questions.explanation: Os marcadores 'First', 'then' e 'ends' descrevem uma sequência clara: causas, possíveis soluções e comparação de impactos. As outras estruturas introduzem tópicos ou gêneros que o excerto não apresenta.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
'The deadline is approaching like a train with no brakes,' the project leader said as the team prepared for the final review.

The comparison suggests that the deadline feels

options.text: distant and unlikely to matter.
easy to postpone without consequences.
fast-approaching and difficult to stop.
literally connected to railway scheduling.
irrelevant because the review was canceled.

questions.explanation: A comparação explícita com um trem sem freios reforça urgência e sensação de avanço inevitável do prazo. É linguagem figurada, não referência a uma ferrovia ou prova de que o encontro foi cancelado.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Some critics say that online meetings always reduce collaboration. Yet, several teams in our study reported more frequent exchanges after introducing short daily video calls.

What is the function of 'Yet' in the passage?

options.text: To add another example supporting the critics' absolute view.
To mark the final step in a set of instructions.
To introduce the cause of the critics' opinion.
To introduce evidence that challenges the preceding claim.
To restate the same claim with stronger wording.

questions.explanation: 'Yet' estabelece contraposição entre a alegação absoluta dos críticos e relatos que não a confirmam. O conectivo introduz evidência contrária, sem provar que todas as reuniões virtuais sejam benéficas.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
This guide is intended for first-time users. It explains how to create an account, set a password and locate the main settings menu. Advanced integrations are covered in a separate manual.

Who is the intended audience of this guide?

options.text: Developers configuring advanced integrations only.
Customers filing a complaint about service charges.
Auditors examining financial statements.
Users who already know every system function.
People beginning to use the system.

questions.explanation: O guia declara ser voltado a 'first-time users' e aborda operações iniciais de cadastro e configuração. Integrações avançadas estão em outro manual; o público-alvo não são apenas profissionais especializados.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Reducing paper use will not solve every environmental problem in the office. Nevertheless, it is an inexpensive first step that staff can take immediately.

Which description best fits the author's stance?

options.text: Supportive but aware of the measure's limitations.
Dismissive of every attempt to reduce paper use.
Convinced that paper reduction solves all environmental issues.
Uncertain whether staff can act without major investment.
Opposed to immediate low-cost environmental actions.

questions.explanation: O autor reconhece que a medida não resolve todos os problemas, mas a recomenda como começo barato e imediato. O tom é favorável e ponderado; não há rejeição da iniciativa nem promessa de solução integral.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
The first paragraph presents a question about declining customer satisfaction. The next two paragraphs analyze survey responses, while the final paragraph proposes changes to support procedures.

The final paragraph mainly serves to

options.text: introduce an entirely new topic with no connection to the survey.
recommend actions based on the preceding analysis.
repeat the original question without responding to it.
replace the survey findings with a fictional story.
explain how the survey sample was first selected.

questions.explanation: A organização enunciada culmina em recomendações para o atendimento após análise dos questionários. Assim, o parágrafo final transforma o diagnóstico em propostas, e não abre tema desvinculado ou apenas repete a questão.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
IT NOTICE: Scheduled maintenance will take place on Sunday from 01:00 to 03:00 UTC. Users may experience intermittent access during this window. No action is required before maintenance begins.

What should users understand from the notice?

options.text: All users must reinstall the software before Sunday.
Access will certainly be unavailable for the entire day.
Service access may be unstable during the specified period.
The maintenance will begin at 03:00 UTC.
Users must submit a support request in advance.

questions.explanation: O aviso aponta manutenção entre 01h e 03h UTC e possibilidade de acesso intermitente nesse intervalo. Não prevê indisponibilidade durante todo o domingo nem exige reinstalação ou providência antecipada.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
PROCUREMENT NOTE: Quotations must include delivery fees and remain valid for at least 30 days. Proposals received after 5 p.m. on 12 August will not be evaluated.

Which quotation meets the stated formal conditions?

options.text: One that excludes shipping but remains valid for 60 days.
One that includes shipping but expires after 20 days.
One that meets all price conditions but arrives on 13 August.
One that includes shipping, is valid for 35 days and arrives before the deadline.
One that omits the validity period and arrives on time.

questions.explanation: A cotação aceita precisa informar frete, valer pelo menos 30 dias e chegar até o prazo indicado. A proposta com 35 dias, entrega incluída e envio tempestivo atende aos três requisitos simultaneamente.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
HELP DESK RULE: Priority 1 incidents involve a complete outage of a critical service. A single user's inability to print while all shared services are running is classified as Priority 3.

How should the printing problem described be classified?

options.text: As Priority 1 because any printing failure is critical.
As an incident with no classification at all.
As Priority 1 whenever the user is a manager.
As a complete outage of all critical shared services.
As a Priority 3 incident.

questions.explanation: A regra distingue interrupção integral de serviço crítico, de prioridade 1, de falha individual de impressão com serviços compartilhados operantes, classificada como prioridade 3. Cargo do usuário não é critério mencionado.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
HR MEMO: Staff members may carry over up to five unused vacation days into the next calendar year, provided that their managers approve the request by 15 December.

Under the memo, carrying over vacation days requires

options.text: managerial approval by the stated date.
automatic transfer of all unused days.
a minimum of six unused days.
approval only after the new year begins.
proof that the employee worked on every weekend.

questions.explanation: A transferência é limitada a cinco dias e condicionada à aprovação da chefia até 15 de dezembro. O verbo 'may' não torna o benefício automático; também não impõe mínimo de seis dias nem exigências de fins de semana.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
SECURITY GUIDELINE: Password-reset links expire 20 minutes after issuance. If a link has expired, request a new one; do not reuse the old message.

What is the recommended procedure after expiration?

options.text: Try the expired link repeatedly until it works.
Request another password-reset link.
Send the old link to a colleague for activation.
Turn off account security checks permanently.
Assume the account is deleted and cannot be recovered.

questions.explanation: A diretriz determina solicitar novo link quando o anterior expira após 20 minutos, sem reutilizar a mensagem antiga. Insistir no link vencido ou repassá-lo não corresponde ao procedimento indicado.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
PROJECT UPDATE: Testing cannot start until the revised specifications are approved. The design team submitted the revisions yesterday; approval is still pending.

Which project activity is currently blocked?

options.text: The submission of the revised specifications.
The initial preparation of the design team's revisions.
The start of testing.
The act of requesting approval in the future.
The completed approval of the revised specifications.

questions.explanation: O início dos testes depende da aprovação das especificações revisadas, que ainda está pendente. A equipe já enviou as revisões; portanto, não é a submissão que permanece impedida, mas a etapa de testes.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
DATA POLICY: Archived records are available to authorized staff for audit purposes. Employees must not download copies to personal devices, even when they have permission to view the records.

Which action complies with the policy?

options.text: An authorized employee saves the records on a private laptop.
Any visitor downloads the records to review them at home.
An employee shares archived copies through a personal account.
An authorized employee views archived records for an audit without personal downloads.
A staff member treats viewing permission as unrestricted copying permission.

questions.explanation: A norma permite consulta aos registros arquivados por pessoas autorizadas para fins de auditoria, mas veda downloads em aparelhos pessoais. Permissão de visualizar não se transforma em autorização irrestrita de copiar.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
SERVICE AGREEMENT: The provider will acknowledge support tickets within four business hours. Resolution times depend on the incident category and are specified in a separate schedule.

What does the four-business-hour commitment cover?

options.text: Final resolution of every incident within four hours.
Automatic closure of tickets that remain unanswered.
An obligation to resolve all incidents on the same calendar day.
A guarantee that response and resolution are identical steps.
Acknowledgment of a support ticket, not necessarily its resolution.

questions.explanation: O prazo de quatro horas úteis refere-se ao reconhecimento do chamado ('acknowledge'), não à solução definitiva. Os prazos de resolução variam por categoria e estão em outro quadro, que não foi reproduzido.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The research unit described its plan as **ambitious but feasible**. It would begin with three pilot sites rather than all forty locations, allowing the team to test its assumptions before expanding the program.

In this context, the word “feasible” is closest in meaning to

options.text: dependent on an unrealistic deadline.
practical and possible to carry out.
costly enough to require a loan.
already completed at every location.
likely to be rejected by the public.

questions.explanation: “Feasible” qualifica um plano executável, reforçado pelo início em poucos locais e pela expansão gradual. Não significa que o projeto já esteja concluído, que seja caro ou que enfrente rejeição; essas ideias não aparecem no trecho.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

After months of unsuccessful trials, the engineers **eventually** identified the source of the vibration. The solution was straightforward, but reaching it required patience and repeated measurements.

The adverb “eventually” indicates that the engineers found the cause

options.text: at regular intervals throughout the project.
by accident on their very first test.
only if the equipment failed again.
after some time and several attempts.
as a result of an unexpected order.

questions.explanation: “Eventually” indica um desfecho alcançado depois de certo tempo, não uma ocorrência imediata. Os meses de testes frustrados sustentam esse sentido. O advérbio não exprime frequência, condição futura nem ordem recebida.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The museum's new curator was **actually** trained as a chemist. Her scientific background proved useful when the staff needed to protect fragile paintings from changes in humidity.

Here, “actually” is used to

options.text: describe the curator’s present duties.
suggest that the curator has no relevant expertise.
to correct a possible assumption.
state that the training is still in progress.
express a rule that must be followed.

questions.explanation: No contexto, “actually” equivale a “na verdade”: revela uma formação possivelmente inesperada. Não quer dizer “atualmente”, nem indica obrigação ou formação em andamento. A experiência científica é apresentada como vantagem.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The publisher has been seeking a **prospective** editor who understands both scientific writing and digital accessibility. Interviews will begin next month, and no candidate has been selected.

The adjective “prospective” refers to someone who is

options.text: in charge of the company’s finances.
guaranteed a promotion this month.
already retiring from the position.
a potential future hire.
responsible for reviewing past sales.

questions.explanation: “Prospective” designa alguém em perspectiva, possivelmente futuro ocupante do cargo. O processo seletivo ainda não terminou, portanto não há contratação garantida. Não se trata de “prosperous” nem de função financeira.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The report noted a small **discrepancy** between the number of parcels recorded at the warehouse and the number delivered to local branches. Managers were asked to check both logs before changing the inventory.

The word “discrepancy” most nearly means

options.text: a delay caused by severe weather.
a mismatch in records.
a request to purchase new equipment.
a formal agreement among suppliers.
a planned reduction in delivery costs.

questions.explanation: “Discrepancy” é uma divergência entre registros, como mostra a comparação entre volumes armazenados e entregues. O texto não trata de economia programada, acordo comercial, compra de máquinas ou causa climática.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The committee has **put off** the public hearing until more residents can attend. The organizers will announce a new date after consulting neighborhood representatives.

The expression “put off” means to

options.text: postpone an event to a later date.
cancel the event permanently.
shorten the event by one hour.
restrict the event to committee members.
broadcast the event live.

questions.explanation: “Put off” significa adiar; a promessa de anunciar nova data confirma essa leitura. O evento não foi cancelado, transmitido nem limitado a membros. A expressão não informa redução de duração.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The editor asked the authors to **back up** each numerical claim with a verifiable source. Simply repeating the figures from the executive summary would not satisfy the review policy.

In the passage, “back up” means to

options.text: withdraw the report from publication.
store all files on an external drive.
support a statement with evidence.
replace figures with opinions.
move the meeting to an earlier time.

questions.explanation: “Back up” assume o sentido de fundamentar afirmações com provas, pois se exigem fontes verificáveis. Embora a expressão possa significar fazer cópia de segurança em outros contextos, aqui não se discute armazenamento de arquivos.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

A **sensible** adjustment to the timetable would give inspectors another day to examine the site without delaying the final delivery. The manager praised the suggestion as balanced and realistic.

The word “sensible” describes an adjustment that is

options.text: sensitive to temperature changes.
designed mainly to attract publicity.
reasonable and based on good judgment.
compulsory under an unnamed regulation.
particularly emotional and unpredictable.

questions.explanation: “Sensible” equivale a sensato, coerente com a avaliação de equilíbrio e realismo. Não é sinônimo de “sensitive”, ligado à sensibilidade. O trecho tampouco afirma obrigação legal, instabilidade emocional ou finalidade publicitária.
questions.section: 2. Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Data retention notice.** Inspection records are stored for five years after a project closes. At the end of that period, records are reviewed for deletion unless an active investigation requires their preservation. Employees must not delete records under a preservation notice.

According to the notice, which procedure is consistent with the retention policy?

options.text: Delete records immediately when a project closes.
Review records, except those held for investigation.
Delete every record exactly five years after its creation.
Preserve all files indefinitely, regardless of status.
Let each employee decide which documents to erase.

questions.explanation: O aviso fixa o prazo a partir do encerramento do projeto e prevê revisão, com preservação se houver investigação ativa. Não autoriza apagamento automático, exclusão imediata ou decisões individuais sem observar a restrição.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**System maintenance bulletin.** A software patch will be installed from 02:00 to 03:30 on Sunday. The public portal may be unavailable during that interval. Submissions already completed will remain saved; draft forms should be downloaded before the maintenance begins.

What are portal users specifically advised to do?

options.text: Discard drafts because they will be saved automatically.
Stop using the portal for the entire following week.
Download unfinished forms before the maintenance window.
Assume the portal will remain accessible without interruption.
Resubmit all completed forms after 03:30.

questions.explanation: O boletim recomenda baixar formulários ainda em rascunho antes da manutenção. Informa que envios concluídos permanecerão salvos e admite indisponibilidade temporária. Não exige reenvio nem paralisação durante a semana seguinte.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Procurement guidance.** All bids must include a technical proposal and a separate price schedule. The evaluation panel will first verify mandatory specifications. Only bids that meet those specifications will proceed to price comparison.

Which statement accurately describes the evaluation sequence?

options.text: Price schedules replace technical proposals.
Bids with missing specifications remain eligible.
Technical and financial documents are prohibited from being separate.
The lowest price is selected before technical review.
Technical compliance is checked before prices are compared.

questions.explanation: A orientação estabelece uma etapa eliminatória de verificação técnica, seguida da comparação de preços apenas entre propostas conformes. Preço menor não dispensa requisitos obrigatórios, e ambos os documentos são exigidos.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Service desk standard.** Requests marked “critical” must receive an initial response within thirty minutes, but the response may be an acknowledgment and a diagnosis plan. The standard does not promise that every critical issue will be fully resolved within that period.

What does the thirty-minute target measure?

options.text: The maximum time to complete any complex repair.
The period during which requests can be submitted.
The interval between scheduled server updates.
The time needed to approve an annual budget.
Initial response time for critical requests.

questions.explanation: O padrão mede o tempo até a primeira resposta ao chamado crítico, que pode ser mero reconhecimento acompanhado de plano diagnóstico. Confundir resposta inicial com solução integral cria obrigação que o texto expressamente afasta.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Accessibility testing note.** The website's new navigation passed automated contrast checks. However, keyboard-only testing revealed that the search filter could not be opened without a mouse. The release team therefore postponed deployment until the interaction was corrected.

Why was deployment delayed?

options.text: A keyboard-accessibility defect remained.
The team had already removed mouse support.
The contrast software found extensive color problems.
The website lacked any search functionality.
The search filter needed more visual decorations.

questions.explanation: Embora os testes automáticos de contraste tenham sido aprovados, o filtro ainda dependia do mouse. A implantação foi adiada por falha de acessibilidade na navegação por teclado, não por ausência de busca ou por contraste reprovado.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Incident postmortem.** An overnight outage began when a scheduled database job exceeded its memory allocation. The monitoring service raised an alert, but the on-call phone number had not been updated. The incident lasted longer because the alert did not reach the current operator.

Which measure most directly addresses the communication failure described?

options.text: Move database jobs to office hours only.
Keep the on-call contact information current.
Remove memory limits from every process.
Increase the frequency of customer newsletters.
Disable all database monitoring alerts.

questions.explanation: O relato diferencia a causa técnica da falha de comunicação: o alerta existiu, mas foi enviado a contato desatualizado. Atualizar a escala de plantão atua diretamente nessa falha; desativar alertas a agravaria.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Inventory audit instructions.** A sample of twenty devices will be selected randomly from the asset register. Auditors must locate each device, verify its serial number and record exceptions. A missing device is an exception even if its purchase invoice can be found.

Under these instructions, what is sufficient to confirm a sampled device?

options.text: An invoice alone, whether the device is present or not.
A photograph of any similar device.
The asset’s estimated resale price.
Physical location and verification of its serial number.
The department head’s verbal assurance alone.

questions.explanation: A auditoria exige localizar o equipamento e conferir seu número de série. Uma nota fiscal não substitui a verificação física, conforme ressalva expressa. Declarações, estimativas de preço e fotos de itens semelhantes também não bastam.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Application programming note.** The endpoint accepts a request identifier supplied by the client. If the same identifier is submitted again with identical content, the service returns the result of the first operation rather than creating a second record. Different content with the same identifier triggers an error.

What is the main function of the request identifier in this process?

options.text: To avoid duplicate records from repeated requests.
Ensure that requests are processed in alphabetical order.
Allow different requests to overwrite each other silently.
Translate input into another programming language.
Encrypt every field transmitted by the client.

questions.explanation: O identificador permite reconhecer uma repetição idêntica e reutilizar seu resultado, evitando duplicação. Reutilizá-lo com conteúdo diferente produz erro; o mecanismo não trata de tradução, criptografia nem ordenação alfabética.
questions.section: 5. Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Community garden update.** The city offered residents unused land and basic tools, but the first planting season produced little food. Rather than abandoning the garden, volunteers attended soil workshops and changed the planting schedule. The following season yielded enough vegetables for a small weekly market.

What can reasonably be inferred from this account?

options.text: The volunteers decided the workshops were unnecessary.
The market had been operating before the project began.
The city withdrew its support after the first season.
They adapted their methods after a poor first season.
The second harvest was smaller than the first.

questions.explanation: A baixa produção inicial levou os voluntários a buscar orientação e modificar o calendário, com melhora posterior. A inferência se sustenta na sequência relatada; não há retirada de apoio, mercado anterior nem rejeição aos cursos.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Library survey.** Among respondents who visited the new library, most praised the reading rooms. Several complained about the limited evening hours. The survey did not include people who had never entered the building.

Which conclusion is NOT supported by the survey?

options.text: Most surveyed visitors appreciated the reading rooms.
Nonvisitors stay away only due to limited hours.
Nonvisitors were excluded from the data collected.
The survey focused on people who used the new building.
Some visitors were dissatisfied with the evening schedule.

questions.explanation: A pesquisa ouviu somente visitantes, portanto não permite explicar por que todos os não usuários deixam de frequentar a biblioteca. As demais afirmações reproduzem dados explícitos sobre amostra, elogios e horários.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Field notes.** A coastal team planned to count seabirds at sunrise on Friday. Strong winds made the cliffs unsafe that morning, so the observation was rescheduled for Saturday. No count was attempted on Friday.

When did the team attempt the observation?

options.text: On Friday afternoon, after the winds weakened.
On Friday at sunrise, as originally planned.
On both Friday and Saturday.
On Saturday at dawn, with all birds counted.
No actual observation is confirmed.

questions.explanation: O texto informa apenas o reagendamento para sábado e afirma que não houve contagem na sexta-feira. Não diz se a atividade ocorreu no dia seguinte. Concluir que foi realizada confunde planejamento com fato efetivamente relatado.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Training program review.** The department introduced optional online lessons. Employees who completed them reported greater confidence with the new software. The review cautioned that those employees might already have been more motivated than their colleagues.

The caution in the last sentence mainly concerns

options.text: proof that the lessons reduced motivation.
the lack of any online training materials.
evidence that the new software was withdrawn.
the assumption that all employees took the course.
possible self-selection among trainees.

questions.explanation: A ressalva aponta possível viés de seleção: quem aderiu às aulas pode ter maior motivação desde o início. Assim, a confiança relatada não comprova sozinha efeito causal do curso. O texto não fala em retirada do sistema.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Regional transit summary.** Ridership rose on routes that received more frequent service. During the same period, fuel prices increased and a major employer opened a new office near one station. The summary did not isolate the effect of each change.

Which interpretation is most cautious and justified?

options.text: Frequency changes were proven to be the sole cause of the increase.
The new employer reduced passenger numbers throughout the region.
All routes experienced exactly the same growth.
Other changes might also explain increased ridership.
Fuel prices were unrelated to commuting choices by definition.

questions.explanation: A elevação de passageiros acompanhou o aumento da frequência, mas houve outras mudanças simultâneas. Como os efeitos não foram isolados, atribuir todo o crescimento ao serviço seria extrapolação causal não sustentada.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Notice to applicants.** Candidates may submit scanned certificates at the initial stage. Original documents will be requested only from shortlisted applicants. The absence of an original at the initial stage will not, by itself, disqualify a candidate.

Which applicant is following the procedure described?

options.text: An applicant who submits no supporting documents at any stage.
An applicant who insists that scanned certificates are prohibited.
Submit scans first, then originals if shortlisted.
An applicant who assumes that all originals are permanently unnecessary.
An applicant who refuses to provide originals after being shortlisted.

questions.explanation: O aviso admite cópias digitalizadas inicialmente e reserva a exigência dos originais aos pré-selecionados. A dispensa inicial não elimina exigência posterior. Negar qualquer documento ou proibir digitalizações distorce o procedimento.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Energy report excerpt.** A school replaced old lights with LEDs in January. Its electricity use fell in February, a month when several classrooms were also closed for renovation. The report recommends comparing more months before estimating savings caused by the lighting change.

Why does the report recommend collecting more data?

options.text: Closures may have reduced electricity use.
Because February bills are legally invalid.
Because renovations guarantee unchanged consumption.
Because LED lamps always increase electricity use.
Because the school did not replace any lights.

questions.explanation: A queda no consumo ocorreu junto com o fechamento temporário de salas, que também pode reduzir gasto elétrico. A comparação ampliada busca separar fatores. O texto não nega a troca das lâmpadas nem estabelece regras sobre faturas.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Oral history archive.** Interviews from the 1980s describe a neighborhood market as a lively social meeting place. Municipal records from the same period focus on building permits and traffic. The historian uses both sets of sources to reconstruct everyday life.

What is the strongest reason for combining the two source types?

options.text: Traffic files directly measure every resident’s feelings.
Both sources were produced for identical purposes.
They offer different kinds of evidence about the same period.
Interviews eliminate the need to check documentary sources.
Municipal records reproduce every personal memory exactly.

questions.explanation: Os depoimentos evidenciam vivências e percepções, enquanto registros administrativos documentam aspectos formais. Reuni-los amplia a compreensão do período. Não são fontes idênticas nem uma substitui automaticamente a outra.
questions.section: 1. Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The visitors **must wear** protective glasses inside the laboratory. In the reception area, glasses are optional unless a safety officer gives different instructions.

The modal verb “must” expresses

options.text: a requirement applicable inside the laboratory.
permission to avoid protective equipment.
a prediction about a future accident.
a preference shared by most visitors.
a possibility with no obligation.

questions.explanation: “Must” expressa obrigação, restrita no trecho ao interior do laboratório. A área de recepção tem regra diferente, salvo orientação específica. O modal não equivale a mera possibilidade, preferência ou permissão de descumprir a norma.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

When the auditor arrived, the finance team **had already submitted** the revised figures. The auditor therefore examined a version that was ready before the visit began.

The past perfect construction indicates that the submission

options.text: was still being discussed in the future.
happened before the auditor arrived.
was only an unrealized intention.
occurred after the auditor left.
takes place every time an auditor visits.

questions.explanation: O past perfect marca um evento anterior a outro fato passado: os números já haviam sido enviados quando o auditor chegou. Não expressa hábito, intenção não realizada nem ação posterior à visita.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

If the supplier **delivers** the parts by Thursday, the workshop **will reopen** on Friday. Otherwise, the reopening date will be reviewed.

Which statement best reflects the conditional meaning?

options.text: Reopening on Friday depends on the parts arriving by Thursday.
Thursday delivery is irrelevant to the reopening.
The workshop definitely reopened last Friday.
Reopening is impossible under all circumstances.
The supplier delivered the parts before the statement was written.

questions.explanation: A estrutura com “if” e presente, seguida de “will”, estabelece condição real voltada ao futuro. A reabertura de sexta depende da entrega até quinta; o texto não confirma que a entrega já ocorreu nem garante a data.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The team **has monitored** the river since 2021 and still publishes monthly measurements. Although the first equipment was replaced, the monitoring project has not been interrupted.

The present perfect suggests that the monitoring

options.text: has no connection with the current project.
happened once and was immediately forgotten.
began in the past and continues into the present.
will begin only after a new grant.
ended permanently in 2021.

questions.explanation: O present perfect, junto de “since 2021” e “still”, indica atividade iniciada no passado e ainda em curso. A troca de equipamento não encerrou o monitoramento. Interpretá-lo como fato concluído contradiz a continuidade expressa.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The grant committee approved the proposal; **however**, the funds cannot be released until the institution provides the missing financial documents.

The connector “however” introduces

options.text: the direct cause of the proposal’s approval.
a chronological list of approved expenses.
an example of the documents already provided.
a contrast between approval and a remaining restriction.
a conclusion that all requirements were satisfied.

questions.explanation: “However” introduz contraste: houve aprovação, mas ainda existe impedimento à liberação dos recursos. Não estabelece causa da aprovação nem comprova cumprimento integral das exigências documentais.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The preliminary report **was reviewed** by two independent specialists before it reached the steering committee. Their comments led to a revised risk assessment.

In “was reviewed”, the passive voice emphasizes

options.text: the report’s ability to review other documents.
the reviewers as the grammatical subject of the clause.
the report as the object of the review process.
a future action that has not yet happened.
that nobody actually examined the report.

questions.explanation: Na voz passiva, “the preliminary report” ocupa a posição de sujeito paciente: recebe a revisão. Os especialistas são os agentes indicados por “by”. Não se afirma que a análise foi futura ou inexistente.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

The director told the coordinators that **they** should submit their schedules by noon. The coordinators later confirmed that all schedules had been sent.

In context, the pronoun “they” most naturally refers to

options.text: the schedules that would be submitted.
the director alone.
the financial specialists in another department.
the members of an unnamed external committee.
the coordinators who received the instruction.

questions.explanation: O pronome “they” retoma os coordenadores, destinatários da ordem e responsáveis pelo envio, como confirma a frase final. Não se refere aos cronogramas, ao diretor individualmente ou a grupos não mencionados.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Unless** the weather deteriorates, the research vessel will leave the harbor at six. The captain will check the latest forecast before confirming departure.

The first sentence means that the vessel will leave at six

options.text: even if departure has been canceled.
because the weather has already deteriorated.
after six hours of continuous bad weather.
only if the weather becomes more severe.
if the weather does not get worse.

questions.explanation: “Unless” equivale a “if not”: a saída está prevista se o tempo não piorar. O texto não diz que as condições já se agravaram nem que a piora é requisito para partir. A confirmação dependerá da previsão atualizada.
questions.section: 3. Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Opinion column.** It is tempting to celebrate every new urban camera as a victory for safety. Yet equipment alone cannot repair poorly lit streets or replace relationships between residents and local officials. Cameras may help, but they are not a complete policy.

What is the main rhetorical purpose of the paragraph?

options.text: To qualify an apparently simple solution by pointing out its limits.
To provide technical instructions for installing cameras.
To report the purchase price of surveillance devices.
To claim that street lighting has no role in safety.
To argue that cameras should always be banned.

questions.explanation: O parágrafo começa com uma percepção atraente e a relativiza: câmeras podem ajudar, mas não substituem outras medidas. O propósito é ponderar limites, não defender proibição absoluta nem oferecer manual técnico ou preços.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Public announcement.** We are pleased to unveil the renovated station next month. Travelers will find wider entrances, clearer signs and sheltered waiting areas. Please consult the updated map before your first visit.

Which description best captures the tone of the announcement?

options.text: Solemnly commemorative of a past disaster.
Sarcastic about the renovation.
Hostile and dismissive toward travelers.
Uncertain whether the station exists.
Positive and informative, with a practical instruction.

questions.explanation: O texto anuncia melhorias com linguagem positiva (“pleased”) e orienta o usuário a consultar o mapa. Seu tom combina entusiasmo institucional e informação prática, sem ironia, hostilidade ou referência a tragédia.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Research brief.** The sensor performed well in laboratory conditions. In outdoor tests, however, accuracy declined during heavy rain. Further trials are needed before the device can be recommended for emergency monitoring.

How does the writer organize the argument?

options.text: By describing only advantages and issuing unconditional approval.
By proving that laboratory testing is always useless.
By providing a complete installation procedure.
By arranging the information as a personal travel story.
By presenting a favorable result, a limitation and a cautious conclusion.

questions.explanation: A organização progride de resultado positivo em laboratório para ressalva em condições adversas e conclusão prudente. Não há aprovação irrestrita nem relato pessoal; a necessidade de novos testes decorre da limitação observada.
questions.section: 4. Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Staff newsletter.** “Our filing system has become a maze,” the coordinator wrote. “Even experienced colleagues need three maps to find a single contract.” She then proposed simpler labels and a revised folder structure.

The image of a “maze” is used to suggest that the system is

options.text: protected by advanced encryption.
confusing and difficult to navigate.
physically located in an underground building.
too small to store a single document.
designed specifically for children.

questions.explanation: “Maze” é metáfora de labirinto usada para expressar a dificuldade de encontrar arquivos. A proposta de melhorar rótulos e pastas confirma a crítica à organização; não se refere a edifício físico ou tecnologia de criptografia.

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Community meeting minutes.** The chair acknowledged that the proposal would reduce noise around the school. Nevertheless, she asked for a revised budget because the projected maintenance costs were missing.

What is the role of “Nevertheless” in the passage?

options.text: To indicate that budget documents have already been approved.
To signal a reservation despite a recognized benefit.
To deny that the school experiences noise.
To introduce a direct consequence of lower noise.
To list another benefit without qualification.

questions.explanation: “Nevertheless” introduz ressalva após o reconhecimento de uma vantagem: a redução do ruído não elimina a necessidade de rever o orçamento. O conectivo é concessivo, não uma confirmação de aprovação financeira.

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Editorial.** A new bus lane is not a magic wand. It will not solve every transportation problem overnight. But dismissing it because it has limitations would mean ignoring an improvement that could benefit thousands of passengers.

Which position does the author defend?

options.text: Only flawless policies deserve public discussion.
The proposal has no potential beneficiaries.
A bus lane will end all congestion immediately.
An imperfect measure may still be worth adopting.
Public transport should never receive investment.

questions.explanation: O autor rejeita tanto a expectativa de solução milagrosa quanto o descarte de toda medida imperfeita. A metáfora “magic wand” nega transformação instantânea; a posição é favorável a avanços parciais justificáveis.

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Memo opening.** Why are our reports taking longer to approve even though the forms are shorter? To answer that question, the quality team examined where documents pause between review stages. Its findings are presented below.

What is the function of the opening question?

options.text: To introduce the problem investigated in the memo.
To announce that no investigation was conducted.
To conclude the memo with a final recommendation.
To suggest that all shorter forms are defective.
To request a personal reply from every reader.

questions.explanation: A pergunta inicial delimita o problema e prepara a apresentação da análise do fluxo de aprovação. É recurso de organização discursiva, não pedido real de respostas individuais nem conclusão após a investigação.

questions.statement:
Read the following passage.

**Project update.** “Only a few minor adjustments remain,” the message said. The attached checklist, however, listed forty unresolved defects, including two that prevented users from logging in.

What effect is created by the contrast between the message and its attachment?

options.text: It shows that the checklist concerns a separate project.
It confirms that the adjustments have no impact.
It turns the statement into a literal estimate of two defects.
It casts doubt on the reassuring description of the remaining work.
It proves that every defect has already been fixed.

questions.explanation: A expressão tranquilizadora contrasta com quarenta defeitos pendentes, dois deles impeditivos de acesso. Essa discrepância produz efeito crítico e enfraquece a minimização do problema, sem indicar que os erros foram resolvidos.
